analysis.title: GS Milhous - CDS Indices positioning update (DTCC)
key_insights: Non-dealer positioning rose across CDS indices over the past week, based on DTCC data.
In Europe, non-dealer risk in iTraxx Xover rose by 2.2bn and in iTraxx Main by 1.1bn.
In the US, non-dealer risk in CDX IG rose by 1.5bn and in CDX HY by 0.6bn.
The positioning chart is adjusted by spread ratio to iTraxx Main. The text does not give the chart's levels.
vol_and_positioning: Non-dealer positioning in iTraxx Xover increased in risk by 2.2bn over the past week (DTCC data).
